candidates.structural_interaction: Earth generating Metal cross-polarity — stability nourishing precision and opening direction
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the Sage: mother ground, nurture in its home element, doubled. You hold people the way land holds houses, unconditionally, for generations, without once mentioning the load. Wisdom settles in you and stays. The whole village builds on your patience. Somewhere in the acreage, keep a field that feeds only you.

k2_functional.mind: You think in generational wisdom: what held the family, what will hold it next.
k2_functional.expression: You comfort in few words: presence that says stay, eat, rest.
k2_functional.bonds: You are the ground floor of your people: permanent, load-bearing, home.
k2_functional.action: You care by carrying: the meals, the moves, the long unthanked logistics.
k2_functional.body: Your body is the homestead: sturdy under routine, honest about weather, deserving repair too.

k2_domain_readings.Knowledge: Your knowledge is settled sediment: practical wisdom layered by years, the kind villages consult. You know what actually works. Write the almanac down. Ground should not be the only copy.
k2_domain_readings.Shelter: Your shelter is the family land itself: people return to you between every attempt at the world. Being home is holy work with no clock. Post seasons. Even land lies fallow.
k2_domain_readings.Mother: The mother-thread is bedrock here: nurture received deep or a hollow you filled by becoming the ground yourself. Either origin made you everyone’s home. Claim one plot back.
